deploy-bot: rolling canary for route `embed-route` -> model v2.4-quant-light in eu-west2. Canary=30% (5 hosts). Watching embed_short and embed_med synthetic probes. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/post-deploy-smoke :rocket:
Nina (oncall): within ~6m seeing p95 explode on embed_short from 90ms -> 530ms, p50 steady. Also a few 504s from probe agents in eu-west2. :thinking_face:
Alex R.: I can repro one host showing long stalls in the quant unpack path. Flamegraph shows big memcpy around the new tile packing stride.
Tess (eng-ml): v2.4 switched to a tighter tile pack for cache locality; we tested small seqs but maybe probe mix includes 32/64/96 which hits a fallback path.
Ravi (releases): suggestion: pause and pin eu-west2 to v2.3-stable, drain canary. Prefer to avoid EU-wide rollout.
deploy-bot: auto-check failed: p95 > 300ms OR error_rate > 1%. Pausing canary and freezing traffic at 30%. :rotating_light:
Nina (oncall): quick curl across canary hosts: ```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST https://eu-west2-canary.api.redwood/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"short"}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code} TIME:%{time_total}\n"
```
Results: host1 HTTP:200 TIME:0.12, host2 HTTP:200 TIME:0.14, host3 HTTP:504 TIME:6.01, host4 HTTP:200 TIME:0.13, host5 HTTP:502 TIME:4.80
Alex R.: collecting perf maps and enabling `--trace-kernel` on host3. Running repro: `./run_repro --model v2.4-quant-light --seqlen 64 --requests 200 --debug-kv`
Tess (eng-ml): try seqlen 96 too. If packing stride causes memcpy fallback we should see latency regressions for mid-lengths.
Ravi (releases): pinning now: ```bash
redwoodctl routes set embed-route --region eu-west2 --model v2.3-stable --reason "post-canary shortseq p95 spike" --owner ravi@redwood.com
```
Ravi (releases): pinned and draining canary hosts. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Route update logged: embed-route pinned to v2.3-stable in eu-west2 by Ravi. Canary hosts removed from rotation. Event: route.pin.user
Nina (oncall): uploading traces and perf artifacts to gs://redwood-traces/1818008888/ (files: flame-host3.svg, perf-host3.pb). Noted kernel memcpy hotspot at 2026-03-22T11:07:42Z.
Tess (eng-ml): opening INC-5712 to track investigation + add mid-length synthetic probe (seq 32/64/96/128). Assigning to eng-runtime + eng-ml.
Alex R.: preliminary hypothesis: quant pack heuristic triggers a slower code path for certain kv tile dims causing higher memcpy and KV eviction pressure. Will attach repro logs to the ticket.
Ravi (releases): adding brief note to release notes and notifying EU early access cohort. We keep the pin until eng-runtime/eng-ml validate fixes or revert packing change.
deploy-bot: Incident auto-created from route pin: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1818008888. Recommended runbook: "synth-fallout-kernel".
Nina (oncall): status: route pinned, canary drained, traces uploaded, ticket opened. Monitoring dashboards for any late regressions. :thumbsup:
